title: AC1021 lineweights three-layout selected output and readback
scope: Qualify the exact three-layout LAYOUT source graph in the existing AC1021 lineweights.dwg for same-version ASCII and Binary DXF selected output, typed readback, destination-preserving refusal, and same-adapter retry.

source.provenance: Existing local file; original author and producer are unauthenticated. No DWG or DXF fixture was added to Git.

independentSourceCrosscheck.root: NOD 0x0c -> ACAD_LAYOUT DICTIONARY 0x1a -> the exact three named LAYOUT records; each BLOCK_RECORD links back to its LAYOUT.
independentSourceCrosscheck.authority: ODA Open Design Specification v5.4.1 §20.4.84 governs the LAYOUT object body and its DWG common-link stream. LibreDWG JSON is a peer cross-check, not the byte-layout authority.

changes: Admit an additional AC1021 LAYOUT source profile only when the exact three identities 0x22/Model, 0x102/ISO A4 Size, and 0x108/Letter Size are present.
Require the exact eleven-key NOD census and bounded empty ACAD_GROUP, ACAD_PLOTSETTINGS, and ACAD_COLOR child dictionaries before selecting the complete NOD profile.
Retain the existing AC1021 two-layout profile and AC1015, AC1018, and AC1024 profile rules.

Extend the existing physical output/readback selector to verify all three layouts, every retained DXF field, exact root/dictionary membership, reciprocal BLOCK_RECORD links, extension DICTIONARY/XRECORD owners and payloads, paper-layout viewport membership, last-active viewport roles, and per-document viewport cardinality.
implementation.selectedOutput: Same-version AC1021 ASCII and Binary DXF. This receipt qualifies the LAYOUT graph only; the four VIEWPORT source callbacks remain unqualified.
implementation.limits: One unauthenticated local producer profile. Local typed readback plus LibreDWG source JSON does not establish native CAD acceptance, producer-wide behavior, full-document output, or a format-wide support claim.

failureAndRetry.negativeControl: Replace the ISO A4 LAYOUT paper-space BLOCK_RECORD reference with DRW::NoHandle. ASCII and Binary export refuse, preserve the existing destination sentinel, and leave prior selected callback qualifications unchanged.
failureAndRetry.retry: Restore the source value and retry with the same adapter instance. Both output encodings pass fresh typed readback.

validation.build: PASS: cmake --build build --target libdxfrw_dwg2dxf_adapter_tests dwg2dxf -j4; target-local -Werror remains enabled.

lineweightsSelector.result: PASS: ASCII and Binary output/readback for Model, ISO A4 Size, and Letter Size; all four paper-layout viewport members map uniquely to emitted records and both last-active targets are checked; invalid-owner refusal and same-adapter retry passed. DXF LAYOUT has no physical viewport-list field, so output list order is not claimed.

validation.existingAc1021TwoLayoutControl: PASS: same selector on /Users/dli/doc/dwg/children-room-decoration.dwg, ASCII and Binary.

strictWholeSource.result: EXPECTED STRICT REFUSAL at 45/49 opaque callbacks; the only remaining handles are VIEWPORT 0x104, 0x105, 0x10a, and 0x10b. All three LAYOUT callbacks are now output-qualified.

validation.ac1024TitleBlockRecheck: An exact-hash AC1024 title_block-arch.dwg compatibility selector recheck stopped before the LAYOUT route because the current adapter rejected partial-read disposition admission. This source-specific gate is separate from the AC1021-only profile change and needs independent diagnosis.
validation.fullSuites: NOT RUN; only touched targets and focused physical selectors were used.

nextAction: Add exact AC1021 source/output binding for VIEWPORT callbacks 0x104, 0x105, 0x10a, and 0x10b. The LAYOUT selector has already established their owning layouts and ordered membership.
